statement: For the six graphs G_a (a in F_7^*) defined by the frozen source under the precise MALS interpretation in problem.md, there is exactly one graph-isomorphism class. The lexicographically ordered G_1 is a reproducible representative, and for every a,b the map (alpha,r,x) -> (u alpha,u^{-1} r,x), where u=b/a in F_7, is an explicit isomorphism G_a -> G_b.
contribution: This completely answers the frozen six-deletion classification: a symbolic adjacency-preservation proof is accompanied by independently regenerated exact adjacency lists and explicit 280-entry permutations for all 36 ordered pairs. The claim is limited to the fixed order-8 Paley matrix and q=7 Desarguesian family; no broader novelty or priority claim is made.
